class.name: Entitlements
class.brief_description: Verify whether a user is entitled to a game/build.

method.name: get_entitlement_record
method.description: Returns the cached entitlement data for the provided download key, or an empty Dictionary if none exists.

method.name: has_cached_entitlement
method.description: Returns true if entitlement data for the given download key is cached.

method.name: is_entitled
method.description: Returns true if the cached record indicates the key is entitled. Returns false if not cached or not entitled.

method.name: verify_entitlement
method.description: Verifies the provided download key against the itch.io API. Emits entitlement_verified on success or entitlement_error on failure.

signal.name: entitlement_error
signal.description: Emitted if entitlement verification fails for any reason. Contains a human-readable error message.

signal.name: entitlement_verified
signal.description: Emitted after verification completes. `success` indicates entitlement and `data` includes details such as key and purchase info.
